name: amfx-spx-gas-price-drop-events
description: amFX reproduction (21DEC22 p1): SPX marked with times when gas prices down 15% or more in 60 days. Blue vertical bands on SPX line chart mark every period when GASREGW fell 15%+ over a rolling 60-day window. Pattern shows these gas drops cluster near equity bottoms. Source: amFX 21DEC22 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: SPX WITH GAS PRICE DROP EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================
# Reproduces page 1 chart from amFX 21DEC22 newsletter.
# Black line = SPX price. Blue vertical bands = periods when US retail
# gasoline prices (GASREGW) fell 15%+ over a rolling 60-day window.
# Insight: gas drops cluster near equity bottoms or early recovery phases.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
spy_close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# DATA: US Regular Gasoline Prices (Weekly from FRED, ffilled to daily)
# =============================================================================
gas_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GASREGW')()
gas = ffill(gas_src.result)

# =============================================================================
# CALCULATION: Rolling 60-day percentage change in gas prices
# roc(period=60) computes (current - N_periods_ago) / N_periods_ago as fraction
# =============================================================================
gas_pct_change_60d = roc(period=60)(gas)

# Event trigger: gas prices down 15% or more in 60 days (roc returns fraction)
gas_drop_event = gas_pct_change_60d <= -0.15

# Band series: show band when event is active, NaN otherwise
band_val = 1000000.0 if gas_drop_event else 0.0 / 0.0

# Time index
idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='Do Big Gas Price Drops Signal Equity Bottoms?',
    category='Gas Price Drops & SPX',
    y_axis_label='S&P 500 (SPY)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY Close', color=Color.Black),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Gas -15% in 60d', color=Color.Blue, is_band=true)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, spy_close, band_val)
